mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for a historic home renovation project with Hometelligent Inc.?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our historic home renovation process typically begins with an initial consultation and thorough assessment of your property and preservation goals. This is followed by design and architectural planning, often involving discussions with local historic review boards. Once plans are approved, we proceed with detailed estimating, material sourcing, and then the construction phase, always adhering to preservation standards. A key process clarity point is our emphasis on transparent communication and project management, ensuring you are informed and involved at every stage, especially during critical decision points regarding historical elements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process starts with consultation and assessment, moves to design and approval by review boards, then estimating, sourcing, and construction, with constant client communication.
